query:
UPDATE bot_accounts
                 SET binding_config = COALESCE(binding_config, '{}'::jsonb)
                     || jsonb_build_object(
                         'connector_control',
                         COALESCE(binding_config->'connector_control', '{}'::jsonb)
                         || jsonb_build_object($2::text, $3::text::jsonb)
                 )
                 WHERE bot_id = $1
